# IconButton

Square, icon-only Button — ghost by default — for toolbars, table rows and headers.

`KenosUI.IconButton` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.IconButton icon={…} aria-label="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.IconButton" icon="{{…}}" aria-label="…"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Square icon-only Button, ghost by default.

## Props (IconButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"solid" \| "subtle" \| "surface" \| "outline" \| "ghost" \| "plain"` | Visual weight. Default "solid". |
| `size` | `"2xs" \| "xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| "2xl"` | Height 24–64px (space-6 … space-16). Default "md" (40px). |
| `palette` | `"primary" \| "accent"` | Default "primary" (black). "accent" (red) for the one main or destructive action. |
| `as` | `string` | Render as another element, e.g. "a". |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Shows a spinner and disables the button. Keeps the width unless `loadingText` is set. |
| `loadingText` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `icon` * | `IconName \| React.ReactNode` |  |
| `aria-label` * | `string` | Required: the button has no visible text. Also used as tooltip title. |

_Also accepts: React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>._
